title: gc import list --json result
description: The rows gc import list prints, in the same order: direct imports sorted by binding, then transitive packs sorted by source.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this command output.

binding.description: Import binding name; empty for transitive rows.

transitive.description: True for packs reached only through another import.

source.description: Declared import source, or the locked source for transitive rows.

version.description: Declared version constraint; empty for path imports and transitive rows.

lock_version.description: packs.lock version; empty unless lock_state is locked.

lock_state.description: locked: pinned in packs.lock; unlocked: remote with no packs.lock entry; path: local directory import.
